notes: Opt-in online adaptation: each completed nnU-Net epoch contributes one full pass over all its actual train-only CP observations. This is a separate stream-learning schedule, not a shortened quality-model training run. Full checkpoint architecture, every bank entry and every candidate are retained. Physical batches are remeasured with real observation loss/backward/AdamW while nnU-Net remains allocated. Raw dataset and immutable graph cache paths must be supplied explicitly by the launcher. DataLoader worker count is inherited from measured quality training and logged; it is not a new feedback-I/O throughput calibration. No observations means no GNN predictions.
